jobs.title: Commercial Storage Trailer Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Seekers can review the Job Applicant Privacy Policy by clicking  here .

Job Description :
Summary The National Product Manager, Trailer Storage Solutions, manages the trailer storage product line strategy, pricing, and operating metric performance for rental, surplus, and Coop assets within FMS. This position will report directly to the Senior Sales Manager and support their assigned product line. This position is responsible for ensuring that the storage application of the trailer fleet is productive and profitable. The National Product Manager, Trailer Storage Solutions, would not only be responsible for collaborating with the Directors in the Region but also the Rental Account Managers and Rental Managers that have in the field oversight of the customers and equipment at their branches. This position will manage to the assigned profitability metrics and represent Ryder at internal and external meetings as requested by senior management. He/she will be responsible for implementing the strategic direction of the product, including information technology, process changes and labor planning. This position is also responsible for ensuring the customer's needs are being met while balancing financial, operating, quality, and safety targets against the requirements of the business measured through leadership competencies and business metrics. The National Product Manager, Trailer Storage Solutions, works in tandem with the sales and marketing organizations to profitably grow market share in trailer sales, specifically for storage use, across the nation.

Essential Functions - Operations Management: Achieve all profitability goals set by Ryder by working closely with assigned Region staff. Ensure regular communication with our leaders and facilitate needed resources to meet objectives.
- Asset Management: Supports the team to ensure the appearance and maintenance of the trailer fleet. Works with regional DORs, RMs, and AMBP’s for Inventory management, policies and procedures Coordinate company inventory and assets to get the best utilization and return on investment of assets
- Customer Management: Ensure delivery of promised services to maximize satisfaction for our customers. Ensure customer satisfaction by meeting maintenance and rental promises.
- Quality Management: Responsible for ensuring Quality Inspections of PM & repairs ensure implementation of Quality Assurance Audit Corrective Action plans and Continuous Improvement programs Oversight of all relevant documentation required to meet and/or exceed local, state, federal, as well as customer requirements Responsible for ensuring a safe workplace and providing guidance for all safety efforts and initiatives Comply with Safety, State, and EPA regulations and requirements.

Additional Responsibilities - Performs other duties as assigned.

Skills and Abilities - Ability to professionally represent Ryder and competently interact with customer management required, Required
- Capacity to understand labor, financial, operating, quality, safety and asset processes and related metrics, Required
- Strong sense of personal accountability and a proven track record of achieving desired results, Required
- Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing, externally with customers and across all levels within the organization, Required
- Competent in basic computer skills and in a Microsoft Office environment, Required
- Ability to influence without authority across the organization, Required
- Ability to work with reporting systems to pull data for analysis and decision making, Preferred

Qualifications - Bachelor's Degree in BBA, Business, Operations, Engineering, Required
- 3 years or more in in Labor Planning or Process Engineering, Preferred
- 3 years or more in in Product Management, Transportation Operations management, role with solution focus. Experience in strategic development, financial analysis, and operating metric performance management, Required
- Mechanical aptitude with knowledge of diesel trucking industry. Intermediate, Preferred
- Must be able to understand financial statements and operating metrics Intermediate, Required

Travel - No

Job Category
Product Management

At Ryder, you’re trusted to make an impact—while enjoying room to grow and having a voice that’s heard. Our culture is built on respect, collaboration, and shared pride in doing great work rooted in innovation and safety.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Job Seekers can review the Job Applicant Privacy Policy by clicking  here .

Job Description :
SUMMARY
The Senior Product Owner, Customer Experience Products, will help lead the strategy, development, and delivery of customer-facing digital products that simplify how customers interact with Ryder services and support organizations. This role is responsible for improving the customer experience through digital self-service, intelligent automation, AI-enabled capabilities, and connected workflows that reduce friction and increase operational efficiency.
They will champion both customer and business needs across a complex ecosystem of applications, platforms, and operational processes. Working closely with designers, technologists, operations leaders, and business stakeholders, this role will help define and execute product strategies that improve customer satisfaction, drive digital adoption, and streamline interactions between customers and Ryder teams.
The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with hands-on product execution and is passionate about leveraging emerging technologies to create modern, scalable customer experiences. This role will translate business objectives, customer needs, and operational challenges into product roadmaps, user stories, and measurable outcomes.
Success in this position requires strong collaboration, customer empathy, analytical thinking, and the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
• Customer Service Product Strategy: Define and execute product strategies that improve customer experiences across Ryder's digital ecosystem, including self-service capabilities, customer communications, workflow automation, and operational engagement experiences.
• Customer Experience Innovation: Identify opportunities to simplify how customers access information, receive support, complete transactions, and engage with Ryder through digital products. Drive solutions that reduce customer effort while improving transparency and satisfaction.
• Automation & AI-Enabled Experiences: Partner with business and technology teams to identify opportunities to leverage automation, artificial intelligence, conversational experiences, predictive insights, and intelligent workflows to improve customer outcomes and operational efficiency.
• Omnichannel Customer Engagement: Support the design and delivery of seamless experiences across digital channels including web, mobile, messaging, communications platforms, and future customer engagement technologies, ensuring a consistent and connected customer journey.
• Product Delivery & Execution: Lead product discovery, roadmap planning, prioritization, and delivery activities. Translate customer and business needs into product requirements, user stories, and measurable outcomes while partnering closely with technology and delivery teams.
• Data-Driven Decision Making: Leverage customer feedback, journey analytics, operational metrics, and product performance data to identify opportunities, prioritize investments, validate outcomes, and continuously improve the experience.
• Enterprise Collaboration: Collaborate with business operations, customer experience, technology, data, and commercial teams to align product strategies with enterprise objectives and ensure successful adoption and implementation of product capabilities.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES
Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION
Bachelor's degree Business Administration, Supply Chain, Computer Science or equivalent.
Master's degree MBA, Supply Chain, Computer Science or equivalent preferred.

EXPERIENCE
Six (6) years or more experience in product management, digital transformation, solution design, business planning, strategy development, competitive analysis and financial analysis.
Eight (8) years or more experience in logistics, operations, engineering, agile development or solution development. Demonstrated experience in new product development preferred. Familiarity with global business practices affecting the supply chain. experience with, or ability to understand, commercial implications of solutions proposed, potential areas of risk and methods to limit liability. experienced in financial business case analysis to help support targeted return on investment. Demonstrated success in assessing, developing and deploying new offerings or incremental enhancements. preferred

SKILLS
• Experience managing customer-facing digital products focused on self-service, customer engagement, workflow automation, or operational efficiency.
• Experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, conversational experiences, virtual assistants, or intelligent automation solutions.
• Experience designing and delivering omnichannel customer experiences across web, mobile, messaging, notifications, and communication platforms.
• Experience working with enterprise SaaS platforms, CRM systems, customer engagement platforms, or workflow management solutions.
•  Experience defining and managing integrations between customer-facing applications and enterprise systems through APIs, middleware, event-driven architectures, or cloud-based integration platforms.
•  Experience partnering with teams supporting platforms such as Salesforce, service management systems, customer engagement platforms, and enterprise operational applications.
•  Strong understanding of customer journey mapping, service design, experience measurement, and digital adoption strategies.
•  Ability to identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, streamline workflows, and improve operational scalability through technology.
•  Experience defining product success metrics and measuring business outcomes through customer, operational, and financial KPIs.

KNOWLEDGE
• Knowledge of digital customer experience, customer engagement platforms, SaaS solutions, workflow automation, artificial intelligence, enterprise integrations, and customer service technologies; advanced level preferred.
• Knowledge of fleet management or transportation logistics industries; advanced level preferred.

TRAVEL
5-10%
